clarifications_incorporated.primary_gate_layer: nonfcs10 (非FCS10内部确认层) — 组级非劣门与目标类 F1 主层

gates.leakage: ID namespace + position/pixel + reserved block exclusion
gates.same_points: identical reference IDs and class table across arms; miss separate
gates.target_improvement: target class F1 mean delta >= 0.03 AND confirmation paired CI supports positive direction (primary layer = nonfcs10)
gates.group_non_inferiority: PRIMARY layer nonfcs10 macro9: paired delta point estimate >= -0.01 AND block-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= -0.02; all-point and fcs10 layers reported in full
gates.new_regression: no confirmable F1 <= -0.05 on adequately supported classes
gates.terrain: condition error reduced on truth/reference; OR decrease alone not accepted
gates.geometry_coverage: no geometric gap in valid-input expected domain; common valid domain class codes consistent
